properties.name: trustpoint:cbom:scope
properties.value: Trustpoint CMP implementation capability; no deployment-specific keys, certificates, secrets, or configuration

properties.name: trustpoint:cbom:review-note
properties.value: CMP protocol version is declared as 2. Change the protocol asset and bom-ref only if Trustpoint actually accepts or emits CMP pvno=3.

properties.name: trustpoint:cbom:enrichment
properties.value: CBOMkit source findings merged with manually maintained Trustpoint protocol assets

properties.name: trustpoint:cbom:scope
properties.value: Trustpoint EST implementation capability; no deployment-specific TLS cipher suites, keys, certificates, passwords, or customer configuration

properties.name: trustpoint:cbom:review-note
properties.value: TLS versions, cipher suites, server certificates, client certificates, and CA signature algorithms are deployment-specific and must be added by an operational CBOM if required.

properties.name: trustpoint:cbom:scope
properties.value: Trustpoint PKCS#11 backend capability; no deployment-specific module paths, token identifiers, PINs, keys, provider versions, mechanisms, certifications, or customer configuration

properties.name: trustpoint:cbom:review-note
properties.value: The effective PKCS#11 version, token capabilities, supported mechanisms, key-size ranges, and provider identity are discovered from the configured provider at runtime and belong in an operational CBOM.

components.name: trustpoint
components.description: Open-source certificate lifecycle management and PKI application for industrial environments.

components.name: Certificate Management Protocol (CMP)
components.description: CMP server-side implementation provided by Trustpoint for certificate enrollment, update, confirmation, and revocation.

properties.name: trustpoint:cmp:transport
properties.value: HTTP POST; HTTPS required for production deployments

properties.name: trustpoint:cmp:message-protection
properties.value: PasswordBasedMac using a shared secret and PBMParameter

properties.name: trustpoint:cmp:message-protection
properties.value: Signature-based protection using RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 or ECDSA

properties.name: trustpoint:cmp:algorithm-selection
properties.value: Concrete digest, MAC, curve, and key parameters are determined by the CMP protection parameters and configured credentials

components.name: CMP PasswordBasedMac
components.description: CMP PasswordBasedMac construction using an iterated one-way function and a message authentication code. The concrete OWF and MAC are carried in PBMParameter.

properties.name: trustpoint:cmp:parameterization
properties.value: PBMParameter supplies salt, one-way function, iteration count, and MAC algorithm

components.name: RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5
components.description: RSA signature generation and verification with PKCS#1 v1.5 padding. The digest algorithm depends on the configured signing credential and CMP algorithm identifier.

components.name: ECDSA
components.description: ECDSA signature generation and verification. The curve and digest algorithm depend on the configured signing credential.

components.name: Enrollment over Secure Transport (EST)
components.description: Server-side EST implementation provided by Trustpoint for CA certificate retrieval, initial certificate enrollment, and certificate re-enrollment over HTTPS.

properties.name: trustpoint:est:transport
properties.value: HTTPS using TLS; concrete TLS versions and cipher suites are deployment-configured

properties.name: trustpoint:est:operation
properties.value: cacerts: supported; unauthenticated GET; returns a base64-encoded PKCS#7 CA certificate chain

properties.name: trustpoint:est:operation
properties.value: simpleenroll: supported; authenticated POST with a base64-encoded PKCS#10 certification request

properties.name: trustpoint:est:operation
properties.value: simplereenroll: supported; authenticated POST with a base64-encoded PKCS#10 certification request

properties.name: trustpoint:est:operation
properties.value: csrattrs: endpoint route exists but is not supported and returns HTTP 404

properties.name: trustpoint:est:authentication
properties.value: HTTP Basic username/password authentication for initial enrollment when configured

properties.name: trustpoint:est:authentication
properties.value: TLS client-certificate authentication for certificate-based enrollment and re-enrollment

properties.name: trustpoint:est:authentication
properties.value: IDevID-based TLS client-certificate authentication for zero-touch initial enrollment

properties.name: trustpoint:est:certificate-output
properties.value: X.509 certificate or CA chain encapsulated as PKCS#7/CMS

properties.name: trustpoint:est:algorithm-selection
properties.value: Certificate public-key and signature algorithms are determined by the submitted CSR, Trustpoint certificate profile, issuing CA, and configured crypto backend

properties.name: trustpoint:est:deployment-mode
properties.value: Certificate issuance can be handled by a Trustpoint issuing CA or an EST registration-authority configuration

components.name: TLS transport for Trustpoint enrollment endpoints
components.description: TLS protects EST transport and provides server authentication and, where configured, client-certificate authentication. Protocol versions, cipher suites, and certificate assets are deployment-specific.

properties.name: trustpoint:tls:scope
properties.value: Generic application capability only; this asset does not assert a concrete enabled TLS version or cipher suite

components.name: Trustpoint PKCS#11 Crypto Backend
components.description: Provider-neutral Trustpoint backend that consumes the PKCS#11 Cryptoki interface to discover token capabilities, manage token-resident key pairs, retrieve public keys, perform private-key signing operations, and destroy managed keys.

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:role
properties.value: Consumer of a deployment-provided PKCS#11 Cryptoki module

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:capability
properties.value: Provider, token, and mechanism capability probing

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:capability
properties.value: Managed RSA and elliptic-curve key-pair generation

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:capability
properties.value: Public-key retrieval and SubjectPublicKeyInfo fingerprint verification

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:capability
properties.value: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 and ECDSA private-key signing

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:key-persistence
properties.value: Controlled by the configured backend policy and provider capabilities

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:key-extractability
properties.value: Controlled by the configured backend policy and provider enforcement

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:provider
properties.value: Deployment-specific; no particular HSM, software token, or vendor module is asserted by this release CBOM

components.name: PKCS #11 Cryptographic Token Interface (Cryptoki)
components.description: Standardized API consumed by Trustpoint to communicate with a deployment-provided cryptographic token or HSM module. The effective interface version is reported by the loaded provider at runtime.

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:interface-version
properties.value: Runtime provider-reported; not fixed by the Trustpoint release

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:implementation
properties.value: Deployment-provided shared library or proxy module

components.name: PKCS#11 RSA Key-Pair Generation
components.description: Generation of managed RSA public/private key pairs through a configured PKCS#11 provider using CKM_RSA_PKCS_KEY_PAIR_GEN. Effective key-size limits and object attributes depend on Trustpoint policy and provider capabilities.

components.name: PKCS#11 Elliptic-Curve Key-Pair Generation
components.description: Generation of managed elliptic-curve public/private key pairs through a configured PKCS#11 provider using CKM_EC_KEY_PAIR_GEN. Trustpoint supports the secp256r1, secp384r1, and secp521r1 curves, subject to provider support.

components.name: PKCS#11 RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5
components.description: RSA signature generation through a configured PKCS#11 provider using either a raw CKM_RSA_PKCS operation with application-side hashing or a provider-side combined digest-and-sign mechanism, depending on policy and provider capabilities.

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:mechanism-selection
properties.value: Raw or combined digest-and-sign mechanism selected according to Trustpoint signing mode and provider capability probe

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:execution-location
properties.value: Private-key operation occurs in the configured PKCS#11 provider

components.name: PKCS#11 ECDSA
components.description: ECDSA signature generation through a configured PKCS#11 provider using either a raw CKM_ECDSA operation with application-side hashing or a provider-side combined digest-and-sign mechanism, depending on policy and provider capabilities.

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:mechanism-selection
properties.value: Raw or combined digest-and-sign mechanism selected according to Trustpoint signing mode and provider capability probe

properties.name: trustpoint:pkcs11:execution-location
properties.value: Private-key operation occurs in the configured PKCS#11 provider
